name: popsicle
headline: CrewAI Blog Generator: Multi-Agent Content
short_description: An AI-powered web app using Streamlit and CrewAI that automates blog creation by coordinating multiple agents for planning, writing, and editing-streamlining content generation with minimal user input. Its applicable for content marketing teams, freelance writers, and businesses looking to scale blog production efficiently using GenAI tools.
author: Arathyvijayachandran

sections.overview:
The Multi-Agent Blog Creator is a Streamlit-based application that automates blog post generation using CrewAI's multi-agent framework. It deploys three specialized AI agents—a Planner, Writer, and Editor—that collaborate to research topics, compose full articles, and proofread content. Users input a blog topic and receive a complete Markdown-formatted blog post in a single click. The tool streamlines content creation for marketing teams, freelance writers, and businesses scaling blog production without manual writing effort.
Content marketing teams generating multiple blog posts efficiently
Freelance writers automating initial drafts and outlines
Businesses scaling blog production with minimal manual input
Quick content prototyping and ideation for editorial calendars
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Arathyvijayachandran/crewai-blog-generator`
sections.usage:
```
Create a blog post for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] about [TOPIC]. The post should be 800-1000 words, include an introduction, 3-5 main sections, and a conclusion. Use a professional yet engaging tone. Include relevant data or statistics if possible.
```

